en.description:
At Youwe, finance is where accuracy meets impact. As a Financial Controller for Youwe Ukraine, you take full ownership of our Ukrainian finance function, from accounting, payroll and tax to reporting, internal controls and audits. Working closely with our international Finance team in Rotterdam and Leeds, you make sure our numbers are right, our processes are compliant, and our finance setup keeps getting smarter.

Key Responsibilities

  • Take end-to-end ownership of accounting for Youwe Ukraine, including bookkeeping, invoicing, supplier administration and fixed assets

en.description: At Youwe, we deliver digital platforms that connect technology, data, and business processes for organizations around the world. As a Project Manager, you lead complex projects from kick-off to go-live, ensuring clients, stakeholders, and delivery teams stay aligned throughout every stage. You also keep your projects on track and tied to real business results, and use AI tools to make your own day-to-day and the project delivery more efficient. Working closely with consultants, designers, developers, and clients, you coordinate planning, communication, and execution to deliver high-quality digital solutions on time and within scope.
en.title: Project Manager
en.requirements:
• 4-6 years of experience as a Project Manager, Delivery Manager, or Product Owner;

  • Experience within a digital agency or complex digital environments is a plus;

  • Strong in stakeholder management and decision-making;

  • Experienced in project and workflow software such as Jira and Confluence;

  • Agile/Scrum experience (pragmatically applied);

  • Comfortable using AI-enabled project and knowledge tools in day-to-day delivery.

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience with international clients;

  • Knowledge of digital platforms and enterprise solutions;
